EventTitle: Caught in running equipment or machinery
Final Narrative: An employee was working on the rig floor assisting in tripping out drill pipe. The employee hand became caught between the hydraulic power tongs and drill pipe tool joint when the driller engaged the backup tong. The employee sustained a traumatic amputation of the left index fingertip and was hospitalized.

NAICS_TITLE: Support Activities for Oil and Gas Operations
Final Narrative: An employee was assisting in pressure testing high pressure 2-inch treating iron to 9500 psi prior to hydraulic fracturing. A hammer union seal failed under pressure
column17: causing the treating iron joint to violently whip. The pipe struck the employee left upper arm resulting in a compound fracture. The employee was admitted to the hospital for orthopedic surgery.

EventTitle: Fall from elevation to lower level
Final Narrative: A derrickman working on the monkey board 85 feet above the rig floor unhooked his fall protection lanyard from the inertia reel while attempting to align a stand of drill collars in the derrick fingers. The worker lost balance and fell approximately 18 feet onto the racking board railing. The worker sustained severe pelvic and femoral fractures and was hospitalized.

EventTitle: Contact with hot fluid or steam
Final Narrative: A refinery process operator was opening a bleeder valve on a high pressure diesel heat exchanger during a unit startup procedure. The valve stem broke free
column17: allowing 480 degree F hot oil and steam to spray out. The operator received second and third degree burns to the chest and arms and was admitted to an intensive burn center.

EventTitle: Caught in pinch point between objects
Final Narrative: A pipeline maintenance technician was troubleshooting an electric motor-operated valve (MOV) actuator on a manifold line. The lockout tagout had been removed to perform a live operational test. While the technician hand was inside the actuator housing gear compartment
column17: the actuator cycled remotely from SCADA. Two fingers were amputated.

NAICS_TITLE: Support Activities for Oil and Gas Operations
Final Narrative: A crew was rigging down a wireline lubricator on a producing oil wellhead. The winch cable clamp slipped
column17: allowing the 250-pound lubricator tool to drop 12 feet from the mast. The lubricator struck an operator hard hat and shoulder. The employee suffered a severe concussion

EventTitle: Inhalation of toxic gas or vapor
Final Narrative: Contractor was performing blind removal on an acid gas flare header. Residual hydrogen sulfide (H2S) gas pocket was released upon parting the flange. The worker SCBA facepiece had not been donned prior to line break. The employee inhaled toxic H2S gas
column18: and was resuscitated and transported to hospital ICU.

EventTitle: Caught in conveyor or rotating machinery
Final Narrative: An employee was inspecting a centrifugal gas compressor skid while the guard was removed for vibration analysis. The employee foot slipped on oily grating into the rotating shaft coupling. The employee suffered severe crush injuries to the right foot and partial amputation of three toes.
